decisions.reason: The plug-in line has its own page and extends the core data integration business at low marginal cost, so it likely meets aspirations and gives no reason for problemistic search.
The building digital twin service is still only mentioned and its results are uncertain, but industry growth and the firm's slack let it keep exploring this emerging market for another year.
The open GIS application framework is central to the strategy of open, extensible components and feeds the project business, so dropping it would hurt core performance.

After withdrawing the overlapping authentication service C, the GIS identity and access service is the consolidated offering for integrating with enterprise systems, so management keeps it even though its visibility is modest.
The newly launched consulting workshop has its own page, uses existing consulting know-how at low cost and helps win project business, so it is too early to judge it below aspiration.
